title: Feature Request: Support for Dexcom Share Servers as Data source
symptom: The user requests support for Dexcom Share servers (US and outside US) as a data source in xDrip+, because they want to use the prediction feature while following.
fix: The thread suggests using Nightscout to collect data from Dexcom Share servers and then setting up xDrip+ as a Nightscout follower. Later, a comment notes that it is implemented as 'Dex SHare Follower'.
evidence_quote: This already indirectly works... 1) Use Nightscout to collect the data from the Dexcom Share servers: http://www.nightscout.info/wiki/welcome/nightscout-with-ios-and-dexcom-share 2) Setup xDrip+ as a Nightscout follower: https://jamorham.gitbooks.io/xdrip-plus/content/xdrip-plus-nightscout-viewer.html
